# Structured planning baseline

The four source JSON files below own versioned scope, decisions, release gates and coverage. GitHub owns live issue state, Assignees, native relationships, discussion and Project values after publication.

| Source | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [project-backlog.json](project-backlog.json) | Program, epics, independently reviewable packages, tasks/subtasks, prerequisites and acceptance |
| [decision-register.json](decision-register.json) | Existing boundaries, proposed decisions, options, accountable roles and release impact |
| [release-manifest.json](release-manifest.json) | Bootstrap evidence boundary and required implementation phase gates |
| [coverage-matrix.json](coverage-matrix.json) | Capability and domain mappings, unknown measurement counts and consumer contracts |

## Generated projections

| Output | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Delivery plan](../docs/DELIVERY_PLAN.md) | Hierarchy, sequencing, decisions and coverage |
| [Dependencies](../docs/DEPENDENCIES.md) | Native prerequisites separated from informational handoffs |
| [GitHub issue payloads](github-issue-payloads.json) | Prepared new-issue inputs with symbolic parent/dependency IDs and baseline Project fields |
| [Issue bodies](issues/CP.md) | Readable bodies for all intended native issues |

There are 81 prepared native issue bodies. Each uses exactly one stable marker such as `<!-- pick-your-ai-catalog-pipeline:CP-01.01 -->`. No output contains invented GitHub issue IDs or a guessed Project number.

Payloads are for **new resources only**. Existing issue bodies, assignees, comments, checklist progress, decisions and Project values must remain intact. Resolve live identities and refresh current state before every mutation; do not replay initial Backlog values into existing work.

Task and subtask checklists are contained only in work-package bodies. Program/epic child tables identify native relationship targets without maintaining a duplicate child-completion checklist.

## Regenerate and verify

```bash
python scripts/render_docs.py
python scripts/validate_plan.py
python scripts/render_docs.py --check
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

The renderer uses only local source files. It performs no network request, GitHub mutation, source retrieval or deployment. `--check` exits nonzero for missing, modified or unexpected generated outputs and never repairs files. Source-byte SHA-256 values in the payload make every input edit traceable.

Do not treat generated documentation as a second editable source of scope. Review planned changes in JSON, regenerate, inspect the diff and verify. Published or observed state belongs in a separate attributable execution receipt; file presence does not establish remote creation.
